title: Catalog API v2: a renamed field and a new one

ticket.subject: Product prices went blank after the supplier's API upgrade
body: Our product loader reads the supplier's catalog API into `bronze.api_products` (a full snapshot each run).
Tonight they roll out **v2** (click **Load day 2** in the Workbench to see it): `price` is renamed
Downstream reads `price`, so it must stay filled for every product, and finance wants `currency` kept in
bronze. One row per `sku`, in the latest state. The loader must work on both v1 (today) and v2 (tomorrow).
Heads-up: bronze enforces its schema. A field the table does not know is refused unless you add it on

requires.message: Load day 2 of the API (the v2 rollout) in the Workbench, then run your ingestion again.

acceptance.text: Every product has its current price in `price`, one row per sku.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sku) AS skus, count(*) FILTER (WHERE price IS NULL) AS no_price, round(sum(price), 2) AS total FROM bronze.api_products
checks.fail: Some products are missing, duplicated, or without their current price.

acceptance.text: The new `currency` field is kept in bronze.

checks.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR') AS eur FROM bronze.api_products
checks.fail: The currency of the v2 products is not in bronze.api_products.

acceptance.text: The v2 run read the whole catalog.

checks.fail: The day-2 run did not read every page of the catalog.

hints: Map the renamed field back before writing: `row["price"] = row.pop("unit_price")` when `unit_price` is there.
`currency` is new: `bronze.merge(..., evolve=True)` adds the column on purpose (existing rows get NULL until they are rewritten).
Each run is a full snapshot: merge on `sku` so repriced products replace their old row.

batches.label: Day 2: catalog API v2 (price renamed, currency added)
